採用・広告の製品.quote: Zendar's RF models provide an efficient temporal-spatial perception foundation for sensor-fusion, capturing many of the benefits of Lidar with the addition of reliable intelligence in any weather and lighting condition.
Zendar provides sensors, compute hardware, and foundational models that enable robots to engage with the real world safely

We provide builders with a production-ready perception stack so they can focus on their application, not rebuilding the same foundational systems from scratch.

Over time, the team realized that if they could open up the perception systems they had built, they could dramatically lower the barrier to entry for others building robotics applications, preventing teams from having to repeat years of foundational work just to reach a starting line.
We provide a perception platform that includes:
Pre-trained, extensible models to accelerate development
Tooling to support training, deployment, and iteration
Efficient execution on small, affordable processors

Zendar's models are designed to deliver strong perception performance while running on efficient hardware, allowing systems to be deployed on more affordable chips and across a wider range of platforms. This reduces cost, power consumption, and complexity, making large-scale deployment practical rather than theoretical.

When builders don't have to spend years recreating foundational perception systems, they can focus on what matters: solving real problems, iterating quickly, and deploying systems that work in the real world.
Zendar's role is to provide the perception layer that makes that possible, so robotics teams can build faster today and scale further tomorrow.
